title: gymnema stramineum
intro: Gymnema stramineum, commonly known as the lesser periwinkle or gymnema, is a plant species belonging to the Apocynaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its ability to aid in weight loss and improve blood sugar control. The therapeutic actions of Gymnema stramineum are attributed to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and hypoglycemic properties, which help to regulate blood sugar levels and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
